_comment: Provider adapters for the floor-plan benchmark. Every paid adapter is disabled and stays disabled in this file. An approved run enables a provider for one invocation only, and needs ALL of: an approved run manifest (runs/approved-run.json), --paid, --enable <id>, FLH_FPA_PAID_RUN equal to the manifest runId, and the provider key in the environment under the harness's own variable name (FLH_FPA_*), so no other key in the environment can be used by accident. imageTokenBound, thinkingAllowanceTokens and modelMaxOutputTokens feed the budget bound in budget.mjs. Values marked unverified must be confirmed before a run.

providers._bounds: Documented: max_tokens is the hard ceiling on total output including thinking; high-resolution image cap 4,784 tokens.
